allowedMediaPrefixes.description:
Media locations this box fetches from, as scheme and host prefixes such
as `gs://my-bucket`. Empty means any URL, including internal addresses.
allowedMediaPrefixes.title: allowedMediaPrefixes

allowedModelKwargs.description:
Model arguments this box passes to the zoo loader. Empty means any.
Set it when anything besides the inference service can reach the box:
some loader arguments are filesystem paths.
allowedModelKwargs.title: allowedModelKwargs

allowedModels.description:
Models this box serves at all. Empty means any zoo model, which lets a
caller fill the disk with weights. Set it to the same list as the
inference service declares for this box.
allowedModels.title: allowedModels

automountServiceAccountToken.description:
Mount the service account token. Off: the model server calls no
Kubernetes API.
automountServiceAccountToken.title: automountServiceAccountToken

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

enabled.description:
Request GPUs. Off runs on CPU, which is enough for small models such
as SigLIP and too slow for SAM2 or video.
enabled.title: enabled

repository.description:
(string) Container image repository. Required: the image is not
published yet.
repository.title: repository

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for a private registry.
imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets

maxLoadedModels.description: Models kept loaded at once, least recently used evicted first.
maxLoadedModels.title: maxLoadedModels

nameOverride.description:
yaml-language-server: $schema=values.schema.json
Overrides the release name in every object's name.
nameOverride.title: nameOverride

enabled.description:
Admit only `networkPolicy.from` to the box. The model server checks no
token, so leave this on unless the cluster enforces nothing.
enabled.title: enabled

from.description:
NetworkPolicy peers allowed to call the box: by default the inference
service's pods in this namespace. Add a `namespaceSelector` to the peer
for an inference service in another namespace. With a LoadBalancer, the
`service.loadBalancerSourceRanges` are admitted as well.
from.title: from

nodeSelector.description: Node selector, for GPU nodes for example.
nodeSelector.title: nodeSelector

preload.description:
Models loaded at startup, by zoo name. Required: `/readyz` answers 503
until one is loaded, so with none the pod never becomes Ready. Name the
models the inference service routes to this box.
preload.title: preload

resources.description:
Not set by default, as in the main chart. A box needs about 16Gi of memory
for SigLIP and Qwen3-VL. Weights in an emptyDir count as ephemeral storage,
so set an `ephemeral-storage` request and limit for them (GKE Autopilot
gives 1Gi otherwise), or use `weights.persistence`. To set them, uncomment
and adjust, and remove the curly braces after `limits:` and `requests:`.
Container resources. With `gpu.enabled`, `nvidia.com/gpu` is set to
`gpu.count` in requests and limits.
resources.title: resources

externalTrafficPolicy.description:
`externalTrafficPolicy` of a LoadBalancer. `Local` keeps the caller's
address, which the NetworkPolicy needs to admit it by range.
externalTrafficPolicy.title: externalTrafficPolicy

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description:
Source ranges a LoadBalancer admits, such as the calling cluster's pod
range. The model server checks no token, so this is its access control.
The NetworkPolicy admits the same ranges.
loadBalancerSourceRanges.title: loadBalancerSourceRanges

type.description:
`ClusterIP` for callers in this cluster. `LoadBalancer` for an
inference service in another cluster, which then requires
`service.loadBalancerSourceRanges`.
type.title: type

serviceAccountName.description: (string) Service account the pod runs as.
serviceAccountName.title: serviceAccountName

failureThreshold.description:
Startup probe attempts, 10 s apart. Nothing listens until the preload
is done, downloads included, so the default allows 15 minutes.
failureThreshold.title: failureThreshold

tolerations.description: Tolerations, for tainted GPU nodes for example.
tolerations.title: tolerations

enabled.description:
Keep downloaded weights on a PersistentVolumeClaim, so a restart
does not download them again and the node's disk is not filled.
Off uses an emptyDir.
enabled.title: enabled

existingClaim.description: (string) Use this claim instead of creating one.
existingClaim.title: existingClaim

storageClass.description:
(string) Storage class of the created claim. Empty is the cluster
default.
storageClass.title: storageClass

sizeLimit.description: (string) emptyDir size limit, when persistence is off.
sizeLimit.title: sizeLimit
